war_axe.notes: Thrown axe; flight frames spin 90deg each (full turn over 4). Do NOT rotate sprite toward heading beyond flip, spin is baked.

fire_spark.notes: Small fast ember with ember trail.

moon_orb.notes: Pale crescent-lit orb with 3 orbiting motes; pulses.

split_shard.notes: Teal shard cracking (frames 2-3); impact = 3 fragments fanning out (spawn split children on impact).

thorn_bow.notes: Thorny green arrow; impact = thorn burst.

spear.notes: Thrown spear, long; alias pierce. Impact is a small pierce flash (pierces through).

sun_beam.notes: Beam origin/muzzle orb (flight) + hit flare. Use with sun_beam_segment and sun_beam_end.

sun_beam_segment.notes: Beam body tile, 4-frame loop. Tiles seamlessly horizontally: pixels span full x 0..31 (side borders intentionally NOT empty). Stretch/repeat along beam axis, rotate by code. Cols 4-7 = hit flare copy.

sun_beam_end.notes: Beam end cap, attaches on the right of the last segment (beam starts at x=0, open left edge). Cols 4-7 = hit flare copy.

ice_fan.notes: Ice shard (fire several in a fan); impact = shatter.

chain_bolt.notes: Lightning; each flight frame a different jagged path (flicker). Use additive blending.

plague_flask.notes: Tumbling flask (rotates 90deg/frame, baked). Impact = green splash; then spawn plague_puddle.

plague_puddle.notes: Ground puddle, ground-plane, not rotated. Flight cols = 4-frame bubbling loop; cols 4-7 duplicate loop (use as fade-out with alpha).

glyph_mine.notes: Stationary pulsing glyph (flight = idle pulse loop, do not rotate). Impact = detonation.

orbit_skulls.notes: Orbiting skull with blinking red eyes, bobbing. Impact = bone shards + dark smoke.

meteor.notes: Falls DIAGONALLY from upper-left to lower-right (baked, 45deg). Do not rotate; flip X for other side. Impact = big ground explosion.

spear_rain.notes: Falls straight DOWN (tip at bottom, baked). Do not rotate. Impact = spear stuck in ground + dust.

dew_splash.notes: Wobbling dew drop; impact = droplet crown splash.

auto_staff.notes: Weapon auto-attack for staff/book: violet magic blob with trail.

auto_daggers.notes: Weapon auto-attack daggers: straight dagger (no spin) with speed lines.

auto_claws.notes: Weapon auto-attack paw-blades: 3 crimson slash arcs sweeping forward (short range). Impact = claw scratch marks.

pierce.notes: Thrown spear, long; alias pierce. Impact is a small pierce flash (pierces through).
